subject: Request: Cygnal multi-year uplift-cap & renewal protection exception
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-18T08:42:00-08:00
Subject: Cygnal — multi-year uplift cap + renewal protection exception request

Folks,

Quick summary: Cygnal (prospect -> strategic pilot) is asking for a 3-year commitment with non-standard economics: 35% net in year 1, 25% in year 2, 15% in year 3, plus an uplift cap that prevents list-price increases >6%/yr and a renewal protection clause that guarantees right-to-renew at no worse than +3% from year 3 for one subsequent year. They also want an SLA exception (see redlines).

Why now: procurement wants definitive pricing for their board approval this week. HubSpot deal attached (HS-987654) and the MA draft is included (Cygnal_MA_plan_v3.pdf).

Asks:
- Marissa: legal redline review and confirm if we can accept the renewal protection language with a one-time cap and escape clause tied to model-cost inflation.
- Karthik / Deal Desk: margin impact and whether we can make this work with a Dedicated capacity commitment or if we should insist on Dedicated-only terms. Please include expected blended unit cost and take rate assumptions.
- Aditya: Exec signoff if risk/finance OK — this will be a strategic reference customer for Healthcare vertical.

Key numbers (prelim):
- ARR equivalent: $2.1M first year (annualized)
- COMMITMENT: 3 years, minimum monthly commitments escalate 5% each year unless uplift cap triggered
- Requested uplift cap: 6%/yr max, and renewal protection of +3% for a single renewal year after term

Attachments: Cygnal_MA_plan_v3.pdf, SLA-exception-redline.docx

Happy to hop on a quick 15 if helpful.

- Jonas
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-18T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cygnal — multi-year uplift cap + renewal protection exception request

Jonas — thanks for the context and materials. Quick notes after a first pass on the MA and the SLA redline: 

1) Renewal protection: we can consider a capped promise but need an explicit escape if macro cost drivers (GPU price or inferred cloud egress) move >10%/yr or if the model family materially changes (e.g., forced migration from LlamaX to a paid model). Propose: add a material-cost-trigger clause and a mutual termination option with 60 days notice within renewal window.

2) Uplift cap math: a 6% hard cap is aggressive. If we accept 6%/yr, we should require a minimum Dedicated commitment and a shared-cost pass-through for quantization or third-party licensing increases. Otherwise, margin erosion hits quickly.

3) SLA exception redline: the proposed 99.6% uptime with financial credits is okay but remove the unlimited liability carveouts we're seeing in Section 12. Suggest a $250k cap tied to contract value and include a force majeure carve-out.

Can Karthik prepare a one-pager on margin impact with and without Dedicated (assume 40% quantization uplift if shared hosted)? I need to see the delta to recommend an exec-clearance ask.

Marissa
VP, Legal & Deal Desk
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-18T13:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cygnal — multi-year uplift cap + renewal protection exception request

Marissa / Jonas — ran the numbers with finance assumptions (attached in-line):

Baseline assumptions:
- Hosted unit cost (token-equivalent): $0.0009
- Dedicated blended unit cost (amortized infra + ops): $0.00045
- Expected consumption pattern: bursty inference ~40% peak; median SLO targets mean we pay 1.8x baseline tokens due to padding

Scenarios (annualized margin impact):
A) Accept 35/25/15 net pricing on hosted: Estimated gross margin Year1 ~18%, Year2 ~12%, Year3 ~8% (negative by year 3 if we see usage upticks).
B) Require Dedicated + 3-yr commit with those nets: Year1 margin ~34%, Year2 ~30%, Year3 ~26% (comfortable).

Recommendation: insist on Dedicated or a hybrid with minimum reserved throughput (commit to N GPUs or equivalent). If we must stay hosted, limit uplift cap to 4%/yr OR bake in a model-cost pass-through tied to changes in third-party license fees.

I'll sketch the Plan A/B options for Aditya's signoff.

- Karthik
Senior Deal Desk Strategist
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-19T09:11:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cygnal — multi-year uplift cap + renewal protection exception request

Team — I reviewed Marissa and Karthik's analysis. Business context matters here: Cygnal is a potential flagship healthcare reference with a reasonable ARR profile and a pilot that could unlock three more accounts. I am willing to provisionally approve the following, contingent on milestones below: 

Executive provisional approval (conditions):
1) Contract must specify Dedicated capacity minimums (or a firm reserved throughput commitment that we can enforce).
2) Uplift cap allowed up to 5%/yr max (not 6%). If third-party model licensing increases >8% in a 12-month period, we can trigger re-negotiation.
3) Renewal protection: allow one renewal-year protection at +3% provided usage variance is within +/-15% of forecast and no force-majeure cost shock.
4) Liability cap aligned to Marissa's recommendation ($250k or 15% of first-year ARR, whichever is greater).
5) Legal to finalize redline and include an exit clause with 120-day notice on material cost triggers.

If Marissa and Karthik confirm these constraints can be codified, I give exec clearance and Jonas can return to the customer with terms and DocuSign. If not, escalate back to me with the sticking points.

- Aditya
Head of Sales Operations
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Turner <emma.turner@cygnalhealth.com>, Cygnal Procurement <procure@cygnalhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-20T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cygnal — multi-year uplift cap + renewal protection exception request

Emma / Cygnal team — thanks for your patience. Internal approval update below and next steps.

What we can provisionally commit to (summary):
- 3-year term with the proposed net pricing cadence subject to a Dedicated capacity minimum OR an agreed reserved throughput metric.
- Uplift cap: firm 5%/year.
- Renewal protection: one renewal year available at +3% provided actual usage remains within +/-15% of forecast and no material third-party cost shock occurs.
- Liability cap and SLA: legal to finalize per our redline (liability cap $250k or 15% of year-1 ARR).

Next steps:
1) I will send an updated MA with the agreed constraints and the SLA redline applied. Expect DocuSign link by EOD — provisional DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/verify/abc123-cygnal
2) Procurement: please confirm Dedicated sizing (or reserved throughput details) by Friday so we can lock infra.
3) Legal: Marissa will send final redlines; Karthik will include the margin appendix for signatures.

Thanks — excited to move forward.
